evals.name: offline-channel-transfer
evals.prompt: write up a guide for getting kolibri channels onto the desktop when it has no internet - i'd download on my laptop and move them over by usb
evals.expected_output: A markdown doc in house style: numbered ## sections from 0, --- separators, per-step verification, troubleshooting table, and a dated verification status table marking unverified claims.

evals.name: backup-runbook
evals.prompt: i need a runbook for backing up the anki collection and the kolibri database to the external drive, something i can follow at the start of each school year
evals.expected_output: A markdown runbook in house style covering both data stores, with verification after each step and a dated fact table.

evals.name: second-learner-setup
evals.prompt: document how to add a second kid to kolibri as their own learner with separate progress tracking
evals.expected_output: A markdown doc in house style covering Kolibri learner/facility setup with verification steps and a dated fact table.
